tools.name: search_shows
tools.description: Search BingeTube (binge.tube), a streaming site for short vertical drama series (1–2 minute episodes), by title or words in the story. Use it when someone asks for a specific short drama, or where to watch one.

tools.name: recommend_shows
tools.description: Recommend short drama series on BingeTube for a mood, trope or story the person likes (e.g. "revenge after divorce", "werewolf romance", "hidden billionaire", "something like ReelShort"). Returns shows with links to watch them on BingeTube.

tools.name: get_show
tools.description: Details of one short drama on BingeTube: what it's about, how many episodes, and links to watch. Pass the show's id or title.

tools.name: top_shows
tools.description: BingeTube viewers' favourite short dramas right now: the ones they keep watching furthest (last 30 days), optionally for one genre.
